title: Open Mic @ Front Street Taproom
event_description: Weekly open mic night featuring music, readings, poetry and more. Travis Neros hosts this all-inclusive creative event welcoming all musicians and performers. Located in downtown Fargo's craft beer destination.
event_venue_information:
About Front Street Taproom

Front Street Taproom is a beloved downtown Fargo venue featuring 30 taps of local craft beers from Minnesota and North Dakota breweries. The taproom has become a hub for the local arts scene with regular events throughout the week.

Events & Entertainment

Beyond the Monday open mic nights, Front Street Taproom hosts trivia nights, vinyl listening parties, and live music on weekends. The venue features The Cellar, an underground comedy club located below the taproom that hosts professional touring comedians and special events.

Atmosphere & Amenities

The rustic wooden decor and comfortable seating create a warm, welcoming environment perfect for creative expression. While food is not served, guests can order delivery from neighboring Rhombus Guys pizza. The venue features a spacious mezzanine available for private events and gatherings.

title: Amped Open Mic @ Troll Lounge
event_description: Monthly open mic night hosted by Amped School of Music. Performers can showcase music, comedy, or poetry in this supportive all-ages environment. Featured monthly themes and community songs to encourage participation.
event_venue_information:
About Troll Lounge

Located inside the Sons of Norway Kringen Lodge, the Troll Lounge is one of Fargo's most unique music venues. The bar features hand-carved wooden trolls and Norwegian murals creating an unforgettable atmosphere that sets it apart from typical performance spaces.

Music Events

The Troll Lounge hosts weekly live music events featuring local and regional musicians playing rock, folk, country, and traditional Norwegian music. The monthly Amped Open Mic provides a low-pressure performance opportunity for emerging artists with professional backline equipment available on stage.

Cultural Experience

As part of the Sons of Norway cultural organization, the venue celebrates Norwegian heritage while welcoming the broader community. The Kringen Kafé serves traditional Scandinavian-American cuisine Tuesday through Friday. Happy hour runs from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM with drink specials.

Venue Details

This is a 21+ venue with special accommodation for performers under 21. Individuals under 18 must be accompanied by a parent, and adults 18-20 are only permitted when performing. The space combines cultural authenticity with modern amenities for live performances.

title: Bluegrass Jam @ Troll Lounge
event_description: Free weekly bluegrass jam session where musicians bring their instruments and join in traditional bluegrass picking. Open to all skill levels, creating a welcoming community for acoustic music enthusiasts.

title: Open Mic @ Hope and Coffee
event_description: Weekly open mic night at Fargo's first nonprofit coffee shop. Family-friendly event welcoming all forms of creative expression including music, poetry, and spoken word. Supportive environment focused on recovery and community.
event_venue_information:
About Hope and Coffee

Hope and Coffee is Fargo's first nonprofit coffee shop, operating as part of Soul Solutions Recovery Center. All proceeds support the mission of helping individuals find recovery and embrace their best life, creating a welcoming space for everyone in the community.

Music & Events

The venue hosts weekly open mic nights on Saturdays, providing a family-friendly platform for musicians, poets, and performers. Additional regular events include karaoke nights, movie screenings, and art-centric classes. The space encourages creative expression in all forms.

Community Mission

Inspired by the original Hope and Coffee in Pennsylvania, this location provides a safe, welcoming environment where those in recovery and the general public merge together. The communal space promotes recovery normalization while offering quality coffee drinks, smoothies, and baked goods in a 1,300 square foot shop.

Amenities

The venue offers free Wi-Fi, comfortable seating for conversation and relaxation, and space for playing cards, trivia, or reading. An attached community center provides additional classes and activities. The Recovery Bookstore is located inside the shop, offering resources and support materials.
